chapter.verse: Zeisu in thu khempeuh mihonpite zak dingin a hilh khit ciangin, Kapernaum khua-ah a lut hi.
Galkap mangpa khat in a it mahmah nasempa khat nei a, tua nasempa cina-in a si dek tak hi.
Galkap mangpa in Zeisu thu a galzak ciangin, Judah upate a kiangah va sawl a, Topa hong pai-in tua nasempa a damsak nadingin a ngensak hi.
Tua upate in Zeisu kiang a tun’ uh ciangin, “Tua thu ama ading na hih nadingin tua pa a kilawm hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih leh, amah in ei pawl hong it a, eite kikhopna inn a lamsak hi,” ci-in a va thuumsak uh hi.

Zeisu in amaute tawh a paikhawm hi. Galkap mangpa’ inn hong naih uh ciangin, galkap mangpa in a lawmte khat sawlin “Topa aw, na kigimsak kei in. Keima inn khum nuai-ah nong lut dingin ka kilawm kei hi.
Tua mah bangin Topa kiangah kong pai ding kilawm ka sa kei hi. Na kamin thu pia leteh, ka nasempa a dam ding hi.

Bang hang hiam na cih leh, keimah in zong mangza-ah hong kikoih hi. Ka nuai-ah zong galkapte a om hi. Tua galkapte khat kiangah, ‘Pai in,’ ka cih ciangin a pai hi. Adang khat kiangah, ‘Hong pai in,’ ka cih ciangin a hong pai hi,” ci-in a gensak hi.
Zeisu in tua thu a zak ciangin lamdang sa a, ama nung a zui mihonte kiangah kihei a, “Ke’n kong cih-inah, hih zah tak upna Israel mipawlte lakah ka mu ngei kei hi,” ci-in a gen hi.
A sawltakte in inn a tun’ uh ciangin nasempa damin a om a mu uh hi.
A sawt loin Zeisu in Nain kici khua khatah pai a, a nungzuite leh mihonpite in amah tawh a pai khawm uh hi.
Khua kongpi kiang a tun’ uh ciangin, numei in ta khat bek a neih si a, a luang a puakkhiat lai tak uh ahi hi. Tua numei in meigong hi a, khuapihte tampi amah tawh a paikhawm uh hi.
Zeisu in tua numei a muh ciangin hehpihhuaisa a, “Kap kei in,” a ci hi.
A khut tawh lang lawng a, a puate a khawlsak hi. Zeisu in, “Tangvalpa aw, tho in ci-in nangma kiangah kong ci hi,” a cih leh,
misipa tho a, thu a gen hi.

Zeisu in tua pa a nu kiangah a pia hi. Mi khempeuh in lau uh a, “A lian mahmah kamsangpa in eite lakah hong piang zo hi. Pasian in ama mipawlte kiangah hong hawh zo hi,” ci-in Pasian’ min a phat uh hi.
Tua thu in Judah gam khempeuh akipan a kimkot gam sung khempeuh ah a kizeel khin hi.
Johan’ nungzuite in hih thu a vekpi-in ama kiangah a gen uh hi.
Johan in ama nungzuite nih sam a, Topa kiangah sawlin, “Nangmah in hong pai dingpa taktak na hi hiam? A hih kei leh midang khat ka lamen lai ding uh hiam?” ci-in a dongsak hi.

Tuate in Zeisu kiang a tun’ uh ciangin, “Nangmah in hong pai dingpa taktak na hi hiam? Ahih kei leh, midang ka lamen lai ding uh hiam? ci-in baptaizpa Johan in nangma kiangah kote hong dongsak hi,” a ci uh hi.
Tua hun lai takin Zeisu in cinatna, zawngkhalna leh, dawi gilo a vei mi tampi damsak a, mittaw tampite zong khua a musak thei hi.

Tua ciangin, “Note pai un la, na zaksa, na muhsa uh thute Johan kiangah va gen un. Mittawte in khua mukik thei uh hi. Khebaite in lam a pai thei uh hi. Phakte in damna a ngah kik uh hi. Bengngongte in khua a za thei uh hi. Misite in hin’na a ngah kik uh hi. Mizawngte kiangah Lungdamna Thu kihilh hi.
Keimah hangin pukna a ngah lo peuhmah in thupha a ngah ding hi,” a ci hi.

Johan’ kamtaite a paikhiat khit uh ciangin, Zeisu in mihonte kiangah Johan thu a gen-inah, “Note in bang en dingin gampa lakah paikhia na hi uh hiam? Huih mut a, a vuang pumpeeng en ding paikhia na hi uh hiam?
Bang en ding paikhia na hi uh hiam? Puanneel silhte en dingin paikhia na hi uh hiam? En un, puan hoih tawh kizeem a, mi nuamsate in kumpite’ inn sungah a om uh hi.
Ahih kei leh, bang en dingin paikhia na hi uh hiam? Kamsangpa en dingin paikhia na hi uh hiam? Ahi mah hi. Pasian’ kamsangpa sang in a lianzaw hi kong ci hi.
Lai Siangtho sungah a kigelh bangin: ‘En in, na pai nading lam sial ding, Na mai-ah ka sawltakpa ka paisak hi,’ a cihna in, tua mipa a cihna ahi hi.
Ke’n kong cih-inah, numei sung pan a suakte lakah Johan sangin a lianzaw khat beek a om kei hi. Ahih hangin, Vantung Gam sungah mi neupen in tuapa sangin a lianzaw hi,” a ci hi.
Siahdongte akipan mite khempeuh in hih thu a zak uh ciangin, Johan’ baptaizna a ngah manun Pasian dik a sa uh hi.
Ahih hangin, Farisaite leh laitheite in amau noptuam nadingin Pasian’ deihna a nial uh a, Johan’ baptaizna a sang kei uh hi.
Zeisu in, “Tulai khang mite bang tawh ka genteh ding hiam? Kua mi tawh kibang ahi uh hiam?
Sumbukah tu-a a om naupangte in khat leh khat kiko-inah, ‘Tamngai ka tum uh hangin, na laam kei uh hi. Ka thuum uh hangin na kap kei uh hi.’ A kici naupangte tawh kibang uh hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, baptaizpa Johan in an lum ne lo, leenggahtui dawn loin hong pai a, note in, ‘Hihpa dawilawm nei hi,’ na ci uh hi.
Mihing Tapa in an ne tui dawnin hong pai a, note in, ‘Hihpa in an hai zu haipa hi. Siahdongte leh migilote tawh zawlin a kiman hi,’ na ci uh hi.
Lungpilna in a tate khempeuh tung panin diksakna a ngah hi,” ci-in a gen hi.
Tua lai takin Farisaite khat in an vak dingin Zeisu a sap khit ciangin, tua Farisaipa’ inn sungah lutin an a ne hi.
Tua khua sungah numei gilo khat a om hi. Amah in Farisaipa’ innah Zeisu in an ne, ci-in a theih ciangin paknamtui suangngo thawl khat paipih a,
a nung lam pan a khe kiangah ding-in kap a, a khe khitui tawh kawtsakin, a sam tawh a nul hi. Ama khe zong nam a, paknamtui tawh a zut hi.
Zeisu an a vak Farisaipa in a muh ciangin, “Hih mi in Pasian’ kamsangpa ahih takpi leh, a lawng hih numei in bang mi ahi, a gilo numei hi, ci-in a thei ding hi,” ci-in a lungsim sungah a gen hi.
Zeisu in zong, “Simon aw, nangma kiangah kong gen ding khat a om hi,” a cih ciangin amah in, “Sia aw, hong gen in,” a ci hi.
Zeisu in, “Sum neipa khat in leiba mi nih a nei hi. Khat in dangka zanga, khat in dangka sawmnga a ba hi.
Amaute in leiba loh nading a neih loh uh ciangin sum neipa in, tuate gel’ leiba a maisak hi. Tua bang ahih leh, tua nihte lakah kua pen in sum neipa a it zaw ding hiam?” ci-in a dong hi.
Simon in, “A maisakna tam zaw a ngah mi in it zaw-in ka um hi,” a ci hi. Zeisu in, “Na up bang a man hi,” ci-in a gen hi.
Tua ciangin numei lam kihei a, “Nang in hih numei na mu hiam? Na innah kong lut lai-in khe sil nading tui nong pia kei hi. Hih numei in ka khe khitui tawh kawtsak a, a sam tawh a nul zo hi.
Na hong nam kei hi. Amah in ahih leh, inn kong lut khit phet akipan ka khe a nam tawntung hi.
Ka lu sathau nong nilhsak kei hi. Amah in ahih leh, ka khe paknamtui tawh hong nilhsak hi.

Tua ahih ciangin, ke’n kong cih-inah ama mawhna tam napi-in a kimaisak hi. Bang hang hiam na cih leh, amah in tampi-in a it hi. A tawmno khat mawhna a kimaisak mi in tawmkha-in a it thei hi,” ci-in Simon kiangah a gen hi.
Numei kiangah, “Na mawhna kimaisak zo hi,” a ci hi.
Amah tawh an ne khawmte in, “Mawhna teng a maisak hih pa in kua mi ahi hiam?” ci a, amau lungsim sung uh ah a gen uh hi.
Zeisu in,”Na upna in nang hong gum zo hi. Nuam in la, pai in,” ci-in numei thu a pia hi.
